narration.text: In 1930, Albert Einstein and Elsa Einstein arrived in San Diego on the Belgenland.
On Dec. 31, 1930, Einstein and Mrs. Einstein were with a reception committee at San Diego.
In San Diego, Einstein was greeted by Mayor Harry C. Clark.
